result.content: # Complete the required API and report.

Stage 1: calibration_limits; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, evidence, policy). Use only records whose claim matches, which are not withdrawn, and whose required conditions exactly match the request. If require_verified, use only verified records. Missing required request conditions yield unknown with their sorted names. Remove source IDs superseded by other eligible records. No eligible sources yield unknown with unknowns=['no matching evidence']. Disagreeing canonical JSON values yield conflict, null value, all eligible sorted source IDs, and unknowns=['source disagreement']. Agreement yields supported (unsupported for the Boolean false), that value, sorted source IDs, and empty unknowns. Return {status,value,sources,unknowns}. Do not treat absent calibration as zero. Do not treat source counts as authority. Do not modify inputs.
Every result must follow OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json. Output objects have exactly the listed fields. Unknown research results have value=null and sources=[]. Use the API arguments supplied by the caller, including earlier policies and evidence; do not substitute current file globals. Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

import copy,json,py_compile; py_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True); from work import evaluate
def ck(g,e): assert g==e,(g,e)
p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}; r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}; ck(evaluate(r,[],p),{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
p={'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}; r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}}}; e=[{'source':'badclaim','claim':'d','value':1,'conditions':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':True},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}}},{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'x':{'b':2,'a':1}},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}]; before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); ck(evaluate(r,e,p),{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}); assert (r,e,p)==before
conf=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'x':3}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':3},'conditions':{'x':3}}]; ck(evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':3}},conf,{'required_conditions':['x']}),{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}); ck(evaluate({'claim':'none','conditions':{'x':3}},conf,{'required_conditions':['x']}),{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(q,ev,pol) for q in reqs]; assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report); print('all checks passed')
